takeaway: Small errors in every turn bend a robot's map out of shape; when it recognises a place it has been, the map is pulled back, with every step taking a little of the correction.
sentence: Small turning errors distort a robot's map, but recognizing a place it has already visited lets it correct all the recorded steps.
reason: It states that turning errors distort the map and recognizing a previously visited place allows correction across all recorded steps.
